latest.title: Fundamental Groups in the Five Dimensional Pan-Rong Conjecture
latest.abstract: Let $M$ be a complete open $5$-manifold with nonnegative Ricci curvature. If its universal cover $\tilde M$ has Euclidean volume growth, then $π_1(M)$ is finitely generated and virtually $\mathbb Z^k$ for some $0\le k\le4$. This confirms a conjecture of Pan and Rong \cite{PR18} in dimension five; see also \cite{BNS25,BrNaSe25}. In dimension six, under the same volume growth assumption, we also obtain a quantitative virtual abelianness result without assuming finite generation of the fundamental group.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 作者证明五维非负 Ricci 开流形若普适覆盖 Euclidean 体积增长，则基本群有限生成且虚 Zk；另得六维定量结果。
latest.breakthrough: 回应五维 Pan–Rong 猜想，推进曲率与无穷远群结构关系。
latest.limitations: 五维结论与六维弱结论不同；Euclidean 体积增长在普适覆盖上要求。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
latest.aiEvidence: 正文 AI disclosure 披露若干关键步骤由 AI 协助解决，作者写初稿并用 AI 改进措辞。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.09080v1（AI 声明/致谢；涉及摘要者同时核对元数据）
latest.priorityReason: 与 Ricci 极限和基本群核心方向最贴近。
